form.title: Volunteer with Welfare Avenue
form.intro: Welfare Avenue serves free, home-cooked meals to unhoused and low-income neighbours in Montreal. Tell us how you would like to help and which Sundays work for you.
form.thank_you: Thank you for signing up to serve with Welfare Avenue. Our team will confirm your Sundays before the day.

cover.alt: Two volunteers plate food side by side: one in glasses and a patterned headband over a green Welfare Avenue vest, one with long dark hair in a beige coat holding a white plate.

questions.label: Phone
questions.help: We text the week of a serving.

questions.label: How would you like to help?
questions.help: Pick up to 2. If you pick 2, our coordinator chooses your role for each Sunday and tells you before we confirm.

options.d: Set up, serve home-cooked meals with care and pack up together. Arrive by noon; about 2 hours.
Cook one dish at home from our recipes, ready by noon: we pick it up or you drop it off.
You drive your own car: bring the food and supplies to the serving and everything back after. You need a licence. About 3½ hours; gas is reimbursed up to $15.
Capture the day for our stories, with care for everyone’s privacy. About 2 hours.
Film short clips of the day for our stories, with care for everyone’s privacy. About 2 hours.
Welcome and talk with the people we serve, then run the short debrief with the team leader. For volunteers who have served with us at least twice; we confirm it with you before the serving.

options.l: I have read what the roles I picked involve (drivers: I bring my own car).

questions.label: Which Sundays can you serve?
questions.help: Servers arrive by 12:00. Pick as many as you like; we confirm each one before the day.

questions.label: Instagram
questions.help: So we can tag you in event photos.

consent.label: Yes, Welfare Avenue can email me news, volunteer call-outs and ways to help. I can unsubscribe at any time.
